purpose: Editorial review signals for recurring AI-associated wording and style patterns. These rules do not determine authorship.

high_signal_terms.rationale: Often used as a polished invitation to explore a topic without naming the concrete action.
Can replace the plainer and usually more precise word use.
Frequently frames a capability as an abstract source of potential rather than stating what it does.
Often supplies a vague positive outcome without naming the actor or measurable result.
Can make a general promise about users or organizations without describing the enabled task.
Signals promotional uplift instead of a specific change in behavior or result.
Often presents access to unspecified value as a dramatic benefit.
Needs the process, step, or measured reduction to be meaningful.
A common formal transition that can replace a direct statement of evidence.
Can introduce promotional framing where a concrete demonstration would be clearer.
Abstractly describes explanation or insight without identifying the evidence.
Broadens a claim without defining which parts of the system or workflow are included.
Signals complexity without enumerating the relevant facets.
Adds emphasis to importance without explaining the dependency or consequence.
Promotional adjective that requires concrete evidence of the claimed transformation.
Metaphorical language that commonly substitutes for a direct description of relationships.
Abstract framing that is often less precise than naming the design or operating model.
Can turn a concrete sequence of tasks into generic transformation language.

context_terms.rationale: Retained as context because it is common in technical writing; review only in a cluster.
Retained as context because it can be technically accurate; request evidence when repeated.
Retained as context because scope claims need checking, not automatic removal.
Retained as context because it is promotional and may be valid only with supporting detail.
Retained as context because a technical distinction may genuinely be nuanced.
Retained as context because it may describe an explicit planning decision.
Retained as context because domain landscape can be legitimate, but generic framing is common.
Retained as context because it is a valid technical term; inspect vague uses.
Retained as context because it can name a real product or integration set.
Retained as context because it is useful when the actual role or group is named.

phrases.pattern: \bit is (?:important|worth|essential) to (?:note|understand)\b
phrases.rationale: Front-loads a generic warning instead of stating the fact directly.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:today's rapidly evolving world|an increasingly digital world|the modern landscape|the ever-changing landscape)\b
phrases.rationale: Uses broad scene-setting that rarely adds technical context.

phrases.pattern: \bas we navigate\b
phrases.rationale: Uses a collective metaphor instead of naming the decision or workflow.

phrases.pattern: \bas organizations continue to\b
phrases.rationale: Introduces a generic organizational subject without identifying the affected team or task.

phrases.pattern: \bat (?:the heart|its core)\b
phrases.rationale: Signals a generalized summary that can often be replaced by the actual mechanism.

phrases.pattern: \ba key consideration is\b
phrases.rationale: Labels importance without naming the decision criterion.

phrases.pattern: \ba crucial role in\b
phrases.rationale: Uses abstract importance language instead of describing the contribution.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:this highlights the importance of|this underscores the need for)\b
phrases.rationale: Repeats a formal conclusion rather than connecting evidence to an action.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:there is no doubt that|it goes without saying|needless to say)\b
phrases.rationale: Asserts certainty where direct evidence or a qualified claim is clearer.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:that being said|with that in mind|at the same time|on the other hand)\b
phrases.rationale: A polished transition that may obscure the actual relationship between statements.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:moving forward|looking ahead)\b
phrases.rationale: Adds time-oriented framing without stating the next action or owner.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:the benefits are clear|the result is a more)\b
phrases.rationale: Claims an outcome without naming the measured benefit or comparison.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:a powerful tool for|a game-changer for|a testament to|a cornerstone of)\b
phrases.rationale: Uses promotional language that needs concrete capability or evidence.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:a wide range of|a variety of|several key factors|several reasons why)\b
phrases.rationale: Signals breadth without enumerating the relevant items.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:let's take a closer look|let's dive in|here's what you need to know)\b
phrases.rationale: Conversational framing can be removed when the next instruction is already clear.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:the following sections will|this guide will walk you through)\b
phrases.rationale: Describes the document instead of helping the reader perform the task.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:it is not about .{1,80}; it is about|.{1,60} is more than just .{1,60})\b
phrases.rationale: Balanced contrast can sound formulaic and often hides the actual distinction.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:not one-size-fits-all|no silver bullet)\b
phrases.rationale: Uses a stock caveat without explaining the specific tradeoff.

phrases.pattern: \bthis is where .{1,50} comes in\b
phrases.rationale: Creates a dramatic handoff instead of naming the mechanism directly.

phrases.pattern: \bthe key takeaway is\b
phrases.rationale: Announces a summary rather than stating the conclusion.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:in summary|to summarize|taken together|in practical terms|in the broader context)\b
phrases.rationale: A generic summary marker; review when repeated or paired with abstract claims.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:when it comes to|in terms of|it depends on several factors)\b
phrases.rationale: Broad framing can replace a precise subject, criterion, or condition.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:while there are challenges, the benefits|although .{1,80}, it is important to)\b
phrases.rationale: A stock concession that can be shortened to the concrete tradeoff.

phrases.pattern: \bboth .{1,60} and .{1,60} play an important role\b
phrases.rationale: Balanced phrasing often adds ceremony without describing the separate roles.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:there are three key areas|let's break this down|step by step)\b
phrases.rationale: Signals a generic structure; retain only when the sequence is necessary for the task.

phrases.pattern: \b(?:a clear and concise overview|a comprehensive solution|a seamless experience|a robust framework|a scalable and flexible approach)\b
phrases.rationale: Combines polished adjectives with an unspecific noun; replace with the actual scope or behavior.

style_signals.rationale: Review only when repeated; a single dash is normal punctuation.
Review repeated semicolons for compressed, heavily balanced prose.
Review repeated colon-led explanations when they create a uniform template.
Review repeated asides when they interrupt direct instructions.
Review repeated selective emphasis; use bold for functional scanning, not decoration.
Review repeated slash pairs for a more precise actor or alternative.
